package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for same_domain_error_mapped_to_multiple_statuses: The same error type being converted to different HTTP status codes in the same module.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

var ErrInsufficientFunds = errors.New("insufficient funds")

type TransferRequest struct {
	From   string  `json:"from"`
	To     string  `json:"to"`
	Amount float64 `json:"amount"`
}

func TransferHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req TransferRequest
	json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req)

	balance := 0.0
	if balance < req.Amount {
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest)
		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"error": ErrInsufficientFunds.Error()})
		return
	}

	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"status": "transferred"})
}

func WithdrawHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req TransferRequest
	json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req)

	balance := 0.0
	if balance < req.Amount {
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusPaymentRequired)
		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"error": ErrInsufficientFunds.Error()})
		return
	}

	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"status": "withdrawn"})
}
